# foliate-js (vendored)

Upstream: https://github.com/johnfactotum/foliate-js — commit 78914aef4466eb960965702401634c2cb348e9b1 (MIT, see LICENSE).
Copied files (incl. `tts.js`, imported lazily by `view.js`) are unmodified except `pdf.js`, which is a stub: PDFs are opened by the app's own
pdf.js-based viewer. Unused upstream parts (OPDS, TTS, dictionaries, UI, tests) are not included.
